confluences.description: avoid entering before the price taps the liquidity zone. Wait for confirmation
you're looking for that rejection wick
Look for exhaustion candles, long wicks, bearish or bullish engulfing or a volume divergence
You want to see volume spike, a quick tap, and a rejection
Price will often wick above resistance, pause, then dump or wick below support and reverse. That is your confirmation
use session times like the London or New York open. That's when the most stop hunts happen
do not chase the breakouts. Wait for price to trap traders and fade the move

you can identify areas that have not been tapped yet where the liquidity should be living
Drop to the 5minut or the 1 minute chart if you're feeling a little bit risky
